title: Smart Data Models - Beehive
description: A managed beehive (colony and its hive body) in an apiary, including its configuration and the latest conditions observed by in-hive sensors

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Beehive

category.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Enum:'langstroth, dadant, layens, warre, topBar, other'. Type of hive body

species.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Scientific name of the bee species housed in the hive

frameCount.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Number of frames currently installed in the hive

queenBirthYear.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Year in which the current queen was born, used to plan requeening

status.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Enum:'queenright, queenless, swarming, robbing, dead, unknown'. Assessed status of the colony

dateLastInspection.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time of the last manual inspection of the hive by the beekeeper

dateObserved.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time of the latest sensor observation in ISO8601 UTC format

weight.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'kilogram (KGM)'. Gross weight of the hive including bees, honey, brood and hive body

temperature.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'degree Celsius (CEL)'. Temperature measured inside the hive, in the brood area

relativeHumidity.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'C62'. Relative humidity measured inside the hive, between 0 and 1

soundPressureLevel.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'decibel (2N)'. Sound pressure level measured inside the hive, an indicator of colony activity and swarming

dominantSoundFrequency.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'hertz (HTZ)'. Dominant frequency of the sound measured inside the hive, used to detect queenlessness and swarming

beeEntranceCount.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Number of bees entering the hive during the last observation period

beeExitCount.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Number of bees leaving the hive during the last observation period

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

refDevice.description: Relationship. Reference to the Device entity of the scale and sensors installed in the hive

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

hasAgriParcel.description: Relationship. Reference to the AgriParcel where the apiary is located
